//: Per-project IDE settings for Cursor / VSCode rust-analyzer.
1. Proc-macro ABI mismatch.  rust-analyzer's proc-macro server
loads .dylibs from target/debug/deps and dispatches to a host-
side rustc.  If the .dylib was built by the project-pinned
bound macro errors with 'mismatched ABI'.  Setting
RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN forces the expander side to match.
rust-analyzer's background `cargo check` all want to write to
target/.  When they overlap they clobber each other's
serde_derive.dylib and the IDE goes red.  Pointing the IDE at
target/rust-analyzer/ keeps the on-chain build artefacts and
the IDE-only artefacts in disjoint trees.
